_comment: Reference sheets. Render with comic_render.py --queue out/sheets.json.

jobs.prompt: a clean reference sheet on white paper. Style: comic panel, razor-sharp confident brush-and-ink line, pristine architectural perspective, crisp silhouettes, clean expressive character geometry, generous negative space. a reference sheet of a cartoonist's tools laid on a green vinyl drafting mat: a green enameled swing-arm lamp, a crow-quill pen, a sable brush, a wooden pen holder with teeth marks near the ferrule, bristol board taped down with brown kraft tape and a faint blue-pencil four-panel grid, three jars holding brushes, rusted nibs and a sand dollar, a braided wool dog bed worn into a crescent, a chipped white enamel mug. Neat hand-lettered labels are allowed on this sheet.
jobs.negative: photorealistic, 3D render, airbrush, neon, anime, watermark, extra fingers
